## Checklist

- [ ] Scoped to the package(s) it belongs to — no drive-by edits elsewhere
- [ ] Tests cover the behavior change (a fix comes with a test that fails without it)
- [ ] Docs updated where the change is user-visible (package README, docs site, root README)
- [ ] `pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm check` pass locally
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]` for user-visible changes
